bullets.id: Emas spot naik 1,7% dan ditutup di $4.141,14 pada Senin, level tertinggi sejak 21 Oktober, karena dolar melemah dan Brent anjlok 5,1% ke $92,61 setelah Trump menyebut serangan baru ke Iran sangat kecil kemungkinannya. Pagi ini emas melunak ke sekitar $4.111 (turun sekitar 0,7%) menurut Trading Economics, menjelang rilis CPI Oktober malam ini.
bullets.en: Spot gold rose 1.7% to settle at $4,141.14 on Monday, its highest since 21 October, as the dollar weakened and Brent slumped 5.1% to $92.61 after Trump said fresh strikes on Iran were highly unlikely. This morning gold eased to around $4,111 (down about 0.7%) according to Trading Economics, ahead of tonight’s October CPI release.

bullets.id: Ekspektasi Fed tetap menjadi rem: CME FedWatch kini menunjukkan peluang sekitar 84% kenaikan bunga Desember, naik dari sekitar 74% sepekan lalu. Yield 10 tahun di sekitar 4,88% dan indeks dolar turun ke 101,68 dari 102,30. Emas masih sekitar 26,7% di bawah rekor $5.608,35 dari Januari dan sekitar 1,4% lebih rendah dalam sebulan.
bullets.en: Fed expectations remain the brake: CME FedWatch now shows about an 84% chance of a December hike, up from about 74% a week ago. The 10-year yield is near 4.88% and the dollar index fell to 101.68 from 102.30. Gold is still about 26.7% below January’s $5,608.35 record and about 1.4% lower on the month.

bullets.id: CPI Oktober terbit pukul 20.30 WIB dan hanya memuat perubahan bulanan; nowcast Cleveland Fed 0,24% (inti 0,21%), RBC 0,3% untuk keduanya, setelah September 0,6% (inti 0,3%). Resistance di $4.150, yang bila ditembus bisa membuka jalan ke sekitar $4.400; support kunci di $4.000. PPI menyusul Jumat 13 November.
bullets.en: October CPI is out at 8:30 p.m. WIB and carries only monthly changes; the Cleveland Fed nowcast sees 0.24% (core 0.21%), RBC 0.3% for both, after September’s 0.6% (core 0.3%). Resistance sits at $4,150, and a break could open the way toward about $4,400; key support is $4,000. PPI follows on Friday 13 November.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram naik Rp15.000 ke Rp2.560.000 dengan buyback naik Rp25.000 ke Rp2.375.000, sehingga spread menyempit ke Rp185.000 (sekitar 7,2%) dari 7,7%. Galeri24 naik ke Rp2.518.000 (buyback Rp2.370.000, spread sekitar 5,9%) dan UBS ke Rp2.572.000 (buyback Rp2.344.000, sekitar 8,9%). Galeri24 kini Rp42.000 lebih murah dari Antam.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price rose Rp15,000 to Rp2,560,000 with buyback up Rp25,000 to Rp2,375,000, narrowing the spread to Rp185,000 (about 7.2%) from 7.7%. Galeri24 rose to Rp2,518,000 (buyback Rp2,370,000, a spread of about 5.9%) and UBS to Rp2,572,000 (buyback Rp2,344,000, about 8.9%). Galeri24 is now Rp42,000 cheaper than Antam.
